title: Bonds in exactly projected pieces: an orbit and a block, and stems
claim: Theorem K*: a bond inside any set of addresses whose projection is exact, holding a distinction at level k and one at level k + s, bounds L_N(k, s); Lemma P: the projections onto an orbit and the block of a lower orbit, and onto a stem (the top orbit with the lower orbit's ancestors at the next d levels) and a lower orbit, are exact. Computed at every depth: the 12 descriptions of KEEP-REACH with an unexposed dependence (5 distinct patterns) are bounded at 5 (2 patterns by orbit-and-block bonds, 3 by stem bonds of depth 2), with no two-orbit bond from level 3 at every distance, so Conjecture C' is false; L_11(3, 5) = L_11(3, 6) = 6 for the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00, 5 patterns (certified lower bound, stem upper bound at every depth); stems of depth 2 give no bond of at most 8 for them from s = 7. Conjecture C* (bounded pieces at both ends) stated. Refereed (CARRIER-R1): confirmed with fixes, no Block; counts narrowed to distinct patterns.
failure_conditions: A bond of an exact piece that is not a bond of the pattern.
A projection onto an orbit and a block, or a stem and an orbit, that differs from the SAT projection.
A bounded verdict for one of the 12 at a depth where a certified search finds no bond of at most 5.
remaining_obligations: Conjecture C* (bounded pieces at both ends; the advisor's pumping idea for 'only if'): open.
Growth of the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00: open; certified test at s = 7, 8 pending (LONG_RUNNING CARRIER-A5).
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; addressed patterns placed by automaton maps, knots within a level or between adjacent levels.
